 Ensuring accuracy post-Election Day
 BY 
 Maryssa Rillo 
 Ventura County 
 PUBLISHED 5:46 PM PT Nov. 09, 2026 
 PUBLISHED 5:46 PM PST Nov. 09, 2026 
 SHARE 
 VENTURA, Calif. — Election Day is over, but election workers are still processing millions of ballots across California.
 On Monday, Ventura County election workers began the process of the 1% Manual Tally Audit. It’s a process to help ensure the accuracy of the tabulation.
